meta.scope: API, web front end and worker

commitments.statement: No personal field is sent to error tracking
Closing an account deletes the customer's data from every store within 30 days
Analytics runs only after the visitor accepts analytics cookies
Data is stored in the EU
commitments.reason: Regions are set by environment variables outside the repository

findings.title: Error tracker receives full request bodies including addresses
findings.subjects: Every customer who checks out and hits an error
findings.flow: 1. POST /api/checkout collects shipping_address and phone (api/checkout/views.py:40). 2. An exception is raised. 3. The error tracker is initialised with PII and request bodies on (api/app.py:22). 4. The body is sent to the error tracking vendor
findings.contrast: worker/app.py:15 initialises the tracker with PII off and a before_send scrubber
findings.impact: Expected (C-01): no personal field reaches error tracking. Actual: addresses and phone numbers of affected customers are stored by the error tracking vendor
findings.fix: Turn PII and request bodies off in api/app.py:22 and reuse the worker's before_send scrubber
findings.guard: Guard for C-01: test raises an error in checkout with synthetic data (user@example.com) and asserts the captured event has no body or user fields

validation.evidence: api/app.py:22 send_default_pii=True and request body capture always on

findings.title: Analytics SDK initialises before consent
findings.data: page views, device identifiers, IP address (behavioural, identifier)
findings.subjects: Every visitor, including those who later decline
findings.flow: 1. main.tsx:9 calls analytics.init() at startup. 2. The consent banner renders afterwards (web/src/consent/banner.tsx:30). 3. Events are sent before any choice
findings.impact: Expected (C-03): analytics only after consent. Actual: every visitor's first page views and identifiers are sent before a choice is made
findings.fix: Initialise analytics from the consent callback for the analytics category
findings.guard: Guard for C-03: test renders the app with no consent and asserts the analytics spy recorded no init or event

validation.evidence: main.tsx:9 init precedes banner.tsx:30 consent handling

findings.title: Account closure leaves customers in the search index
findings.flow: 1. POST /api/account/close deletes the user and orders (close.py:31). 2. The customer document in the search index is never removed. 3. Staff search still returns it
findings.impact: Expected (C-02): every store is cleared within 30 days. Actual: the search index keeps closed customers indefinitely
findings.fix: Remove the customer document from the search index in the closure path
findings.guard: Guard for C-02: test closes a synthetic account and asserts the search index returns no document for it

validation.evidence: close.py:31-45 has no search index call; index writer at api/search/customers.py:12
